reasons: Y has a clearer first-second-third reading chain from foreground soybean soaking trough to midground tofu mold and wet cloth to background finished tofu and steaming area.
Y has stronger near/mid/far transitions and occlusion depth; X has more visual competition among the foreground bamboo tray, wooden tub and right-side mold.
Both pass material realism, while Y differentiates wet, dry, rough and absorbent surface states more richly.
Y shows more production evidence—water inflow, soaking soybeans, pressing mold, press cloth, finished tofu and steaming equipment—so it reads more like an operating workshop.
X is quieter, cleaner-looking and offers slightly easier typography space, but Y has the stronger editorial spatial narrative and memory point.
evaluator_verdict.tradeoff: Y has stronger production narrative and spatial layering but is denser and more dramatic; X is calmer and easier to typeset but tells a less complete workshop story.

recurring_tradeoff: B can become denser or more deliberately staged.
Typography quiet-zone advantage is not guaranteed.
Color-temperature control is not independently proven.
